releaseNotes: Implement shake detection and command bar functionality
changelog: Added ShakeDetector for detecting shake gestures using accelerometer.
Introduced ShakeMath for processing shake events and maintaining state.
Created CommandBarState and CommandBarViewModel to manage command bar UI state and logic.
Developed CommandBar composable for user interaction, including voice input and command processing.
Implemented unit tests for RuleBasedCommandInterpreter and ShakeMath to ensure correct command interpretation and shake detection logic.
